analysis_plan.reference_pool: original fact codes only (fixed across conditions)

checkpoint.lineage_note: DEV on locally available pretraining checkpoint; legacy SFT accumulation child file absent so effect sizes are NOT directly comparable to +15.22pp history

CLEAN_DEV_EFFECT_requires: paired effect with CI excluding 0 or exact p < 0.05
matched control passes sanity (C0 near baseline)
VALUE_RECENCY_DOMINANT_if: C2_vs_C0 carries most of C3_vs_C0 and C7_vs_C8
RELATIONAL_PAIR_DOMINANT_if: C4 and C5 both well below C3

competing_hypotheses.H_A_entity_addressing: query/entity presence routes retrieval; C1 helps, C4 (wrong entity) does not
competing_hypotheses.H_B_value_recency: correct value-token recency/activation explains effect; C2 ~= C3, C4 ~= C3
competing_hypotheses.H_C_relational_pair: correct ENTITY<->VALUE relation required; C3/C7 >> C1,C2; C4,C5,C6 low
competing_hypotheses.H_D_competitive_interference: any duplication helps by biasing competition; C8 ~= C7
competing_hypotheses.H_E_mixed: multiple components contribute; report decomposition, not single winner

C0.text: Memo: use only the listed refs.

distractor_selection: deterministic per-task D* via SHA256(SEED, task_id, distractor-choice); D* entity/code reused for C4/C5/C6/C8
evidence_level: DEV (same-generator development; NOT fresh, NOT structural-OOD)
insertion_rule: original block unchanged; insert single line immediately before final query/Answer; query wording unchanged; MARK family (C9-C11) edits target line in place with code never deleted

evaluator_mechanistic: correct value rank among original visible values
query-conditioned binding margin (gold - mean other original codes)
outcomes.primary_behavioral: strict free-generation correctness (exactly one code and equals gold)

purpose: Isolate WHY query-matched fact duplication outperformed distractor duplication in binding_factorial (+15.22pp): entity presence vs value recency vs correct pair vs general interference
seed_determinism: SHA256-derived seeds only; no Python hash()
stopping_rule: single DEV run N=120 on baseline failures; no peeking-driven N expansion; replication only as separate preregistered run
